properties.description: A proposed Decision is a decision point: register alternatives under it as lightweight Artifact pointers (branch-by-file, each naming its export), GOVERNED_BY the Decision and CONTRADICTS their siblings — the fork held open. Refuses registering under a settled decision. Collapse chooses a winner: the Decision moves to accepted, losers are superseded (OBSOLETES, retired on the record not deleted), and the outcome + rationale are written into the Decision's own alternatives field. The teeth: the undecided_decision_point DETECT gap surfaces a proposed Decision with >=2 alternatives as an open fork ('which do you choose?'), anchored so it clears on collapse. The winner's content-merge reuses apply_merge. BL-70 rung 2; ops set_decision_status, register_alternative, alternatives_for, collapse_decision.
properties.name: Hold and collapse a decision point (forkable alternatives)
